t: These Site Varnik Stretch Work Trousers with holster pockets are high-performance trade trousers designed to provide maximum flexibility and durability on site. Ideal for carpenters, plumbers and busy trade professionals, these slim-fit trousers feature 4-way stretch fabric and a smart stretch waistband for unrestricted movement during active workdays. Built-in knee ventilation keeps the wearer cool, while Cordura-reinforced knee pad pockets offer essential protection. Practical pockets, including holster, thigh and ruler compartments, and a built-in carabina clip, keep tools close at hand. Windproof and water-repellent properties ensure reliable weather protection, while a heavy-duty YKK metal zip fly delivers long-lasting durability.
b: 2 x Holster, 2 x Front Hip, 2 x Thigh, 2 x Back, 2 x Knee Pad & 1 x Ruler Pocket(s)

Knee Vents Allow Breathable Ventilation & Cooling
